description:
Born in Harlem, an inferior omega, and a tattoo artist—Mikey's life was a hardcore noir. To survive in the backstreets, sometimes, one had to risk more than just their life.
While working as a loader on a film set, Mikey was caught badmouthing the famous actor Ryu.

*"I can’t believe I’m being discriminated against by a trash-life Yankee. F\*cking great."*

It was embarrassing, but he figured they’d never meet again.

*"Hello, Miki."*

Out of nowhere, Ryu appears and asks for a tattoo. And he doesn’t seem to have any intention of leaving. With Ryu visiting his home almost daily, Mikey’s life turns into a complete mess.
*"What, are we dating or something?"
"Dating? With you, Miki?"*
Does he even realize who he is? A world-famous sex symbol, ridiculously handsome, and a wealthy dominant alpha. No matter how he looked at it, there was no reason for a man like Ryu to get involved with a low-life Yankee like him. So he tried to push him away. "I won’t rush you to remember. But you must remember." Just what happened in the past to make him act like this? As the mystery deepens, fragments of long-forgotten memories begin to resurface… 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
